audience: resource managers and project teams using Hub Planner

useCases.title: Check team allocations
useCases.text: Find a resource by name or email, then look up bookings overlapping the dates you need to review.

useCases.title: Compare booked and logged time
useCases.text: Retrieve bookings and time entries for the same resource or project and date range to compare planned work with recorded time.

useCases.title: Find active projects and clients
useCases.text: Search projects by status or exact name and browse client records for project planning.

useCases.title: Record completed work
useCases.text: Create a time entry for a resource and project on a specific date. A Read & Write key is required; check the minutes and details before recording.

useCases.title: Create a client record
useCases.text: Add a client by name with a Read & Write key. Check existing clients first to avoid creating a duplicate.
